pr_title: Bluetooth: CAP: Add support for handling ASE errors
pr_body:
If we get an error/rejection from the CAP acceptor when
performing the Unicast Audio Start or Stop procedure then
we need to abort the procedure and let the application determine
what the next step is.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/78264

issue_context.title: LE Audio: CAP Initiator: handle errors from ASCS
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
If the CAP initiator uses the BAP unicast client to perform a ASCS procedure that then fails for whatever reason (rejected by server, server disconnects). 

In the case of a rejection we will get both a notification with the reason why it was rejected, and presumably a GATT write response with an error as well. 

In the case of a disconnection event, only the write callback will be called. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The CAP initiator should use the `struct bt_bap_unicast_client_cb` to deal with error notifications, as we won't get endpoint notifications in those cases. 

Errors should trigger an abort on the procedure. 

In case of a disconnect we have `bt_cap_common_disconnected` that handles this, so those are already handled. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A
comments: In the case that the CAP initiator gets a disconnection, then `bt_cap_initiator_released` will always be called from the BAP Unicast Client, which would finalize the procedure, so nothing needs to be done in the case of disconnects.
